item.description: MUMBAI: Neeraj Ghaywan’s “Homebound”, the much-acclaimed drama about two rural friends and their aspirations, has been shortlisted in the best international feature category at the Oscars alongside 14 other films. item.description: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar condemned the terror attack during a Hanukkah celebration at Sydney’s Bondi Beach, saying that India and Israel both have a policy of “zero tolerance” against terrorism.
